headline: Approved statutory tax exemption applications and one motor vehicle excise abatement denial; finalized ATB settlement with Merrimack St properties.
summary: The Board of Assessors approved minutes from a prior meeting, approved motor vehicle excise abatements including one denial, and approved multiple statutory tax exemption applications. The board also reported finalizing an ATB settlement with Merrimack St properties and noted FY27 certification is on track.
decisions: Approved minutes from the July 28, 2026 meeting.
Approved motor vehicle excise abatement for the week of July 20 to July 24 by signatures.
Approved motor vehicle excise abatement for the week of July 27 to July 31 by signatures.
Approved 1 motor vehicle excise abatement for denial.
Approved statutory exemption applications under Clauses 17E, 22, 22D, 22E, 22H, 37A, 41C, plus 1 Senior Volunteer and 1 Veteran Volunteer.

decision_evidence.quote: R. Rondeau made a motion to approve the minutes, E. Brideau 2nd – Unanimous.
Week of July 20 to July 24 – Approved by signatures
Week of July 27 to July 31 – Approved by signatures
MVE Abatements for denial – 1, R. Rondeau made a motion to approve, A. Lombardo 2nd – Unanimous.
R. Rondeau made a motion to approve these applications, A. Lombardo 2nd – Unanimous.

MINUTES  
  
THE MEETING OF THE BOARD OF ASSESSORS   
LOWELL MA August 13, 2026
  
A meeting of the Board of Assessors took place on August 11, 2026, at 9:30 AM in Room 36 at 
Lowell City Hall:  
In attendance: Chief Assessor; E. Brideau, Deputy Chief Assessor; R. Rondeau, Assessor; A. 
Lombardo
E. Brideau called to order the meeting at 9:30 AM
1. Review of minutes from July 28, 2026 meetings – R. Rondeau made a motion to approve
the minutes, E. Brideau 2nd – Unanimous.
2. Applications for MOTOR VEHICLE EXCISE TAX ABATEMENTS (supporting         
 documentation attached to each application)  
  Motor Vehicle Excise Abatements
o Week of July 20 to July 24 – Approved by signatures
o Week of July 27 to July 31 – Approved by signatures
o MVE Abatements for denial – 1, R. Rondeau made a motion to approve, A. 
Lombardo 2nd – Unanimous.
3. FY27 Certification – it is on track, and will begin submitting to the State the week of 
August 17th
4. Statutory Exemptions – Clause 17E: 7 applications, Clause 22: 13 applications, 22D: 3 
applications, Clause 22E: 10 applications, Clause 22H: 1 application, Clause 37A: 2 applications, 
Clause 41C: 11 applications, 1 Senior Volunteer, and 1 Veteran Volunteer – R. Rondeau made a 
motion to approve these applications, A. Lombardo 2nd – Unanimous.
5. New Business – BOA finalized an ATB settlement with Merrimack St properties
6. Old Business – None
Motion to adjourn at 9:43 AM R. Rondeau, A. Lombaro 2nd – Unanimous.
Respectfully submitted,
Chornai Pech
Administrative Assistant
